question: The Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology is a science award in India given annually by which of the following scientific bodies?

options.text: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)

solution:
The correct answer is the __**Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology** is awarded annually by the **Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)**.
 
• Dr. Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar, is one of the most prestigious science awards in India.
 
• The award is **given to scientists below the age of 45.**
 
• It honours exceptional research contributions made in India during the last five years.
